title: inconsistent extension-check idiom between cleanup_tmp_files and cleanup_orphan_msg_files
description: cleanup_tmp_files uses path.to_str().is_some_and(|s| s.ends_with('.msg.tmp') || s.ends_with('.env.tmp')) while cleanup_orphan_msg_files was fixed in round-5 to use path.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == 'msg'). These two functions do the same kind of work at startup; a contributor who copies either will create the same inconsistency again. The to_str() path also has the latent non-UTF-8 skip-silently bug that round-5 was explicitly fixing.
